exposure: fetal APGAR score at five minutes
outcome: Robson's Ten Groups Classification System (TGCS) group
cohort: 168 females who underwent caesarean section at Unit II GMMMC Civil Hospital Sukkur between January 2022 and June 2022
finding: The most frequent Robson's TGCS groups were Group 10 (52.9%), Group 5 (15.4%), and Group 1 (12.4%), with fetal distress (18.8%) and prior cesarean section (22.4%) being the most common indications for cesarean section.
birth_weight: recorded, but no specific range provided
